name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
summary: During Hallow's End, a young orphan named Jesper lies sick in the Stormwind orphanage, wishing he could join in the holiday festivities. Too ill to go out, he asks Alliance adventurers to go trick-or-treating across the world on his behalf.

sections.title: A Sheltered Child
sections.body: Jesper lives in the orphanage in Stormwind's Cathedral Square, and this Hallow's End he has fallen sick. Denied the simple childhood joy of gathering sweets from across Azeroth, Jesper stays indoors, hoping passing adventurers might share in the holiday spirit and collect treats in his stead.

sections.title: Tricks for Treats Across the Alliance
sections.body: To gather the holiday spread Jesper dreams of, an adventurer must travel far beyond Elwynn Forest. The quest demands visiting the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as the gnome exile Talvash del Kissel. Each adult demands a performance before relinquishing their prize—forcing travelers to cluck like chickens, dance, flex, or chug like a train in exchange for regional sweets like Stormwind Nougat and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.

faq.answer: Jesper is a young orphan living in the Stormwind orphanage. During Hallow's End, he longs for holiday candy but is too sick to go out and gather it himself.

faq.q: Why can't Jesper go trick-or-treating himself?
faq.answer: Jesper is sick, and his illness keeps him inside the orphanage while the rest of the city celebrates Hallow's End.
He requests four distinct regional confections: Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mints, Darnassus Marzipan, and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.

faq.q: Where do you obtain the Gnomeregan Gumdrop?
faq.answer: Because Gnomeregan remains irradiated and overrun, the gumdrop is handed out by the gnome refugee Talvash del Kissel, who is currently staying in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What tricks do the innkeepers make you perform?
faq.answer: Innkeepers demand silly antics in exchange for sweets: flexing your muscles in Stormwind, dancing in Darnassus, clucking like a chicken in Ironforge, and making a train noise for Talvash.

faq.q: What does Jesper give you in return for the candy?
faq.answer: After receiving the assortment of four holiday candies, Jesper happily trades some pumpkin treats he has saved up for the traveler.

angles.text: This holiday effort ties the distant capitals together, asking heroes to travel from the grand streets of Stormwind to the mountain halls of Ironforge and the boughs of Darnassus to bring joy to an orphaned child.
With their home lost to troggs and radiation, gnomish participation in the holiday falls to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge, who ensures Gnomeregan Gumdrops are still shared.
